patterns.name: Sine
patterns.description: Smooth sinusoidal wave motion. Gentle, continuous up and down movement ideal for slow teasing or sustained stimulation.

patterns.name: Fast Stroke
patterns.description: Quick full-range strokes. Rapid up and down movement for intense stimulation at high speeds.

patterns.name: Slow Tease
patterns.description: Slow, deliberate strokes with pauses. Builds anticipation with extended holds at extremes.

patterns.name: Pulse
patterns.description: Rhythmic pulsing motion in mid-range. Quick pulses centered around 50% position.

patterns.name: Edge Hold
patterns.description: Long slow strokes to the edge with extended holds. Builds to near-climax then backs off.

patterns.name: Grind
patterns.description: Short, grinding movements at the top. Small range motion focused on the upper region.

patterns.name: Depth Thrust
patterns.description: Full depth thrusting motion. Deep strokes from top to bottom with consistent rhythm.

patterns.name: Random Tease
patterns.description: Varied positions with irregular timing. Unpredictable movements that keep stimulation interesting.

patterns.name: Wave Build
patterns.description: Gradual intensity building wave. Starts slow and increases in speed before resetting.

patterns.name: Shallow Fast
patterns.description: Fast shallow strokes. Quick movements in the lower third for focused stimulation.
